name: Werewolf
flavour: Something howls where the skeletons walked.
art_prompt: a hulking werewolf with dark grey-black shaggy fur, a wolf's head with a long snout, two small yellow eyes, its mouth open wide showing white fangs and a red tongue, long muscular arms with big clawed hands hanging low, ragged torn green trousers with a rope belt, hunched forward, realistic beast proportions
motion: stalking forward in place with a heavy hunched beast walk, long arms swinging low
gait: stalking in place on the spot, hunched, the long clawed arms swinging low, the wolf head forward
anim_negative: extra arms, a third arm, extra legs, extra heads, a second creature, a human face, standing straight
back_hint: Its back is covered in the same dark shaggy fur, the wolf ears show above the head from behind, the long arms hang at its sides with the claws visible, the torn green trousers and rope belt stay.
dead_hint: lying flat on its back on the ground, dead: eyes shut, jaw slack with the tongue out, the long arms flopped out to the sides with the claws up, its body stretched out sideways across the picture with its head on the left and its feet on the right
doc: A beast that walks like a skeleton (the skeleton's numbers) in threes; three looks from a real wolf to a cartoon (WW-A, WW-B, WW-C), walked on the Orc Walk retargeted to its long arms. Placed by the Level Editor.
note: Pass 53 (Garry): from _REFERENCES/2d/Werewolf.webp (Klein edits picked by eye, tools/gen_edit_stills.py), small eyes and a mouth showing teeth in every look; the walk is Mixamo's Orc Walk on tools/dl/drivers/orc_walk_wolf.

WW-A.note: Like the reference: a realistic dark beast

recipe.art_prompt: a hulking werewolf with dark grey-black shaggy fur, a wolf's head with a long snout, two small yellow eyes, its mouth open wide showing white fangs and a red tongue, long muscular arms with big clawed hands hanging low, ragged torn green trousers with a rope belt, hunched forward, realistic beast proportions

WW-B.note: Stylised: bigger head and hands, tufted fur

recipe.art_prompt: a werewolf in a stylised cartoon style with a bigger wolf head, thick arms and big clawed hands, dark grey-black fur drawn as bold tufts, two small yellow eyes, a wide open mouth full of white fangs, ragged torn green trousers with a rope belt, hunched, bold simple shapes

WW-C.note: Very cartoony: round head, chunky claws, short legs

recipe.art_prompt: a very cartoony werewolf with a big round wolf head, tiny bead-like yellow eyes, a huge grinning mouth full of white fangs, short stumpy legs, oversized chunky clawed hands, dark grey-black fur painted flat and simple, ragged green trousers with a rope belt, hunched and goofy

WW-D.note: WW-A's front with a back walk that matches it (pass 60): the same front painting, a back painted to the front's hunched wide stance, and the back walk driven on the Orc Walk like the front. WW-A's and WW-B's back walks were free clips: every driven try put the clawed feet on the clip's bottom edge, so the back view's stick figure is shrunk 12% (orc_walk_wolf_b88).

recipe.art_prompt: a hulking werewolf with dark grey-black shaggy fur, a wolf's head with a long snout, two small yellow eyes, its mouth open wide showing white fangs and a red tongue, long muscular arms with big clawed hands hanging low, ragged torn green trousers with a rope belt, hunched forward, realistic beast proportions
recipe.back_hint: Seen directly from behind it keeps exactly the stance of the reference: hunched far forward with the head sunk low between the huge shoulders, so only the top of the head and the two pointed ears show above the shoulder line; the massive arms bowed out wide of the body and hanging low, the big clawed hands reaching down to knee height; the legs set wide apart and bent at the knees, the big clawed feet planted wide. The same dark grey-black shaggy fur covers its back, the same ragged torn green trousers and rope belt. No face, no snout, no eyes visible.
